name: PUMapbox
description: Interactive Mapbox map powering the Explore screen. Supports light and dark styles, pan, zoom, and gesture controls. On web built on react-map-gl; on iOS built on MapboxMaps SDK.

props.name: dark
props.description: Switches between Mapbox streets-v12 (light) and dark-v11 styles

platforms.android: N/A - use MapboxMaps Android SDK directly

props.name: style
props.description: Additional CSS styles applied to the map container (web only)

notes: iOS `sourceFile` is null even though status is `implemented` - iOS consumes the MapboxMaps SDK directly (see `dependencies.ios`) rather than through a PurpleUI-owned wrapper component, so there is no PurpleUI-iOS source file to point to.

accessibility.notes: Delegates to the underlying Mapbox SDK's own accessibility behaviour (web: mapbox-gl's built-in ARIA landmarks; iOS: MapboxMaps SDK's UIAccessibility support). PUMapbox itself adds no extra labelling - any custom pins/overlays layered on top (see PUMapPin) must carry their own accessible labels, since the base map won't describe them.
